about.pl: Litania loretańska w postaci, w jakiej modli się nią Polska: tekst rzymski z jednym wezwaniem własnym. Do tekstu poświadczonego w Enchiridion Indulgentiarum z 1952 r. Stolica Apostolska dodała Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) oraz w 2020 r. Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei i Solácium migrántium, a obok nich Polska mówi Regína Polóniæ, zatwierdzone dla niej w 1920 r. Wezwanie Mater misericórdiæ Polska otrzymała już w 2014 r., a list z 2020 r. przeniósł je na miejsce, które zajmuje tutaj, po Mater Ecclésiæ.
about.en: The Litany of Loreto as Poland prays it: the Roman text with one invocation of its own. To the text attested by the 1952 Enchiridion Indulgentiarum the Holy See added Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) and, in 2020, Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium, and beside them Poland says Regína Polóniæ, approved for it in 1920. Mater misericórdiæ had already been granted to Poland in 2014, and the letter of 2020 moved it to the place it holds here, after Mater Ecclésiæ.

translation.pl: Módl się za nami, Święta Boża Rodzicielko.
translation.en: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.

translation.pl: Abyśmy się stali godnymi obietnic Chrystusowych.
translation.en: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

translation.pl: Panie, nasz Boże, daj nam, sługom swoim, cieszyć się trwałym zdrowiem duszy i ciała, i za wstawiennictwem Najświętszej Maryi, zawsze Dziewicy, uwolnij nas od doczesnych utrapień i obdarz wieczną radością. Przez Chrystusa, Pana naszego. Amen.
translation.en: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord God, that we Thy servants may enjoy lasting health of mind and body; and by the glorious intercession of Blessed Mary, ever Virgin, be delivered from present sorrow and enjoy eternal gladness. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

editorial.notes: The current Roman form. Its historical core is collated against the 1952 Enchiridion; later invocations are supplied from the Holy See documents that inserted them in 1980, 1995 and 2020.

source.method: The 1952 Enchiridion supplies the historical core; Mater Ecclesiae, Regina familiae, Mater misericordiae, Mater spei and Solacium migrantium are supplied by the respective Holy See decrees of 1980, 1995 and 2020. Regina Poloniae is supplied by the Sacred Congregation of Rites' approval of 14 January 1920 and the current Polish bishops' text. The resulting Roman recension for Poland is collated against TPL and the cited decrees.
